file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-based). Use for large files

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Use for large files

pages.description: PDF only: the pages to read, such as "3", "1-5" or "1,3,7-9". At most 20 per call

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
